messages:
hannah: FYI launched a 4% canary for the prefetch-ttl increase + mini-aggregator change. Target: reduce tokenization and coalescer fragmentation on sub-48 sequences.
jia: Replayed 48h of typical traffic, short-chat bucket wins are visible. p50 down ~13%, p95 down ~9%, p99 down ~22%. Cost per token improved ~10%.
rollout-bot: Canary artifacts: https://internal.redwood/bench/2389990001
```
aggregate (shard-mean):
- p50: 26ms -> 22.6ms (-13%)
- p95: 132ms -> 120ms (-9%)
- p99: 410ms -> 320ms (-22%)
- cost/1k tokens: $0.075 -> $0.067
- 5xx rate: 0.10% -> 0.11% (no signal)
```
tom: Good numbers. What are the safety/rollback conditions? We need mem growth, queue tail, and error uplift covered. Also have we updated the public customer status page text?
hannah: Canary policy:
```
canary_pct: 4
ramp: 4 -> 30 in 45m -> 100 in 3h
eval_window: 10m
rollback_if:
  p99_rel_increase_pct: 12
  error_rate_rel_increase_pct: 0.6
  cuda_mem_growth_mb: 40
  sustained_queue_tail_ms: 50
```
mike: Added temporary route that pins seq > 64 to stable kernels. Also enabled a short-lived microcache bump for prefixes length <= 8 to increase hit-rate.
jia: Observed improved packing: small-batcher coalescer had 11% fewer fragmentation events, which explains p99 drop. No sustained CUDA memory delta during the first 30m.
hannah: Heads-up to product and support: short blurb for weekly release notes? Keep it one line with numbers.
mike: Draft for release notes: "Runtime prefetch + small-batcher tweaks reduced median latency by ~13% and p99 by ~22% on fast-chat flows; estimated token cost down ~10%."
jia: I'll attach a seq-length heatmap to the canary artifact and a short note about the fallback logic.
rollout-bot: Canary will auto-ramp unless a trigger fires. Monitoring hooks bound to runtime.prefetch.*, runtime.coalescer.* and gpu.memory.delta. PagerDuty escalation enabled for 2h.
hannah: Thanks all. If green at 2h we'll flip to 30% then full roll. Keeping an eye on the alerts. :rocket:
